items.title: Africell Updates Customers as The Gambia Switches to 9-Digit Mobile Numbers
items.summary: By Makutu Manneh Africell Gambia has announced that the prefix 87 will be added to its customers’ existing phone numbers as The Gambia begins its transition from a seven-digit to a nine-digit national numbering system at midnight on Sept. 4, 2026. The nationwide change, overse...
